notes:
Bitify 1.8.0

New logo. Bitify's own mark - the equaliser bars on the dark plate - on the launcher icon, the splash screen and in the notification shade.

Messages, rebuilt. A room of its own: a deep-black conversation on the brand backdrop, charcoal tiles, one rose accent. It opens from a Messages button in the top bar now.

Podcasts, now Indian. A new section arranged by kind and language - horror, comedy, business, true crime, news, cricket and more, plus Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Marathi, Bengali and Punjabi - with a Trending in India row. Video episodes play as video; films stay out.

Songs play without the internet. Offline replays now live in the app's own storage, so Android's Clear cache no longer wipes them. Clear song cache still frees the space on demand.

Fixes. The update check answers honestly - up to date, version ready, or couldn't check - a video podcast no longer opens in the audio-only player, and back from Messages returns to where you were.

About 71 MB on a 64-bit phone (61 MB on 32-bit, 77 MB on x86_64), SHA-256 checked, installs over 1.7.4 - nothing to uninstall.
